newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philrealty 1996 net 1.047 bln pesos. [CORRECTED 10:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Philrealty 1996 net 1.047 bln pesos. [CORRECTED 10:00 GMT]

text.p: Philippine Realty and Holdings Corp (Philrealty) said on Friday its unaudited net income in 1996 rose to 1.047 billion pesos from 423 million (corrects from 208 million) in the previous year.
"A big boost for our income last year came from the sale of our Philippine Racing Club Inc shares," said executive vice president Amador Bacani.
Bacani said the sale of his firm's stake in Philippine Racing last year contributed 800 million pesos to Philrealty's earnings.
Philrealty's revenues in 1996 reached 2.102 billion pesos from the previous 2.288 billion pesos.
Bacani said Philrealty's revenues from sales of real estate projects were higher in 1995 compared to last year but it paid higher taxes.
"Property sales are subjected to a 35 percent tax while stock sales of publicly listed firms like PRCI are subjected to a tax of one half of one percent," he said.
PRCI president Walter Brown said he expected Philrealty's net income in 1997 to be "close to what we earned in 1996."
"Our income this year will come mostly from real estate projects," he told Reuters.

Brown said Philrealty was optimistic about its building projects in the emerging business district of Fort Bonifacio as well as the firm's other office and residential condominium projects in Metro Manila.
